item.title: Shigeru Miyamoto To Receive The Inaugural 'Legend Award' At The 30th D.I.C.E. Awards

description.p: Award will be presented only once per decade.The Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences (AIAS) has announced that Shigeru Miyamoto, the creator of iconic Nintendo franchises like Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda, will receive the inaugural Legend Award at the upcoming 30th Annual D.I.C.E. Awards ceremony on Thursday, 18th February 2027.The award, which will only be presented once per decade, 'recognises an industry icon whose enduring vision continues to redefine interactive entertainment'. It's designed to honour creators whose achievements have already earning lasting universal acclaim, while celebrating their 'immeasurable impact and influence'.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

description.p: Whipped into shape.Indiana Jones and the Great Circle is one of the biggest surprises in recent years. Developer MachineGames, well known for its ability to make gunning down Nazis immensely satisfying in its Wolfenstein franchise, created what is arguably the best Indy adventure since The Last Crusade.Yet transitioning from Wolfenstein wasn't exactly easy for the studio. In a new interview with the FRVR podcast (thanks, VGC), design director Jens Andersson explains how the developers found it "very tough" to focus on melee combat, given its expertise in gunplay.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Random: Modder Transforms DS Into A Home Console, And It's Super Cool

description.p: Meet the DualStation.We have long pondered what a DS library would look like on Nintendo Switch Online for some dual-screen, big-screen action. Nintendo is yet to give us the real deal, so modder KOUZEX has taken things into his own hands, creating a build that converts our beloved clamshell into a full-blown home console. And yes, it's super cool.The above video introduces the DualStation, a mod build that combines an original DS motherboard and a bunch of unique components into a system that boasts quite an impressive array of features. We're talking full 60Hz HDMI output, touch controls via just about any means you can think of (controller, mouse, Joy-Con, drawing tablets), Bluetooth controller support, a built-in mic and a bunch of other bells and whistles.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
